speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Intestinal Atresia (likely Jejunal or Ileal)

The X-ray findings of dilated bowel with a gasless rectum confirm a complete obstruction distal to the jejunum. Given the normal ultrasound and lack of a palpable mass, we are looking at a congenital blockage rather than a volvulus or intussusception. We should proceed with an abdominal X-ray with a contrast enema or immediate surgical consultation to locate the atresia.
